classification: Descriptive evidence only; not primary, significance, acceptance, quiet-host, allocation attribution, or measurements of late edits.

audit.initialDraftDisposition: The initial private draft mistakenly used the midpoint of min and max for n=3. It was overwritten before review, is not retained, and is not accepted. This corrected report recomputes from unchanged collection/native JSON and includes sorted raw triples.
reportNotes: Each successful process ran the owned Rendering.NativeDefaultAndWarpResourceLifecycle probe at four cycles; zero exit and completed reports indicate its in-process assertions passed.
The probe requires image decode, stable source, idle/hidden no-render/no-preparation behavior, exact viewport restoration, resource-generation advance, and window/native-host retirement.
The probe byte-compares native captures before and after each of three device recreations. This was asserted in-process; no external image review was performed.
Initial preparation is the first completed native preparation after initialization, not total startup time.
n=3 summaries are descriptive only; no statistical significance, acceptance, or causal claim is made. This separate 24-process study does not replace the twelve-slot primary family.

independentAudit.acceptance: numerical/integrity audit only; no policy self-approval

interpretationLimits: Resource study: 24 successful processes, n=3 per role in each of four view/renderer cells; all 60 cost rows and 8 final-memory rows are retained with the corrected sorted triples and medians.
The corrected resource audit explicitly supersedes an unaccepted initial midpoint draft; its report artifact is SHA-256 bound as 6671C14D5DEA97DF6E2275AB7EACF4C7BDE1B22BC37C6039D08E725A407BBCDA.

Resource in-process assertions included image decode, idle/hidden behavior, viewport restoration, device-generation advance, source preservation, retirement, and capture byte comparison; no external image review occurred.
Initial preparation is the first completed native preparation after initialization, not total startup. Resize and recreate rows are separate observed stages.

Stage diagnostic: 16 processes, two ABBA/BAAB blocks per scenario, 64 cycles each; four per-run medians per actor and all 50 descriptive stage rows are retained. Stage comparator status is review-required and its control drift/finding fields are reproduced without self-acceptance.

No isolated causal allocation attribution is available from these studies; process CPU/cycle/wall measurements are costs only. Neither study estimates late edits beyond the exact source identities bound above.

Machine hostname, user identity and private filesystem paths are omitted; resource adapter model and numeric device identifiers are retained to identify renderer hardware cells without a host identity.
